test('legal natural refinery destruction refreshes immediate demand',()=>{const gs=games();let observed=false,elapsed=0;const targets=gs.map(g=>g.state.entities.find(e=>e.id===3));for(const g of gs)eq(g.run('power(0)'),{supply:120,demand:80},'before natural destruction');while(elapsed<160&&!gs[0].state.result){for(const g of gs)g.step(.25);elapsed+=.25;pair(gs,'natural destruction step '+elapsed);if(targets[0].hp<=0||!gs[0].state.entities.includes(targets[0])){observed=true;break}}ok(observed,'natural combat actually destroys initial refinery');for(const g of gs){eq(g.run('power(0)'),{supply:120,demand:50},'immediate natural destruction demand');ok(!g.state.entities.some(e=>e.id===3&&e.hp>0),'destroyed refinery excluded')}pair(gs,'natural destruction final');measurements.push({naturalRefineryDestroyedAt:gs[0].state.t,observationStep:.25})});

test('closed accessible experimental setting and zero default allocation',()=>{const g=fresh(),p=g.element('displayPreview'),c=g.element('vehicleArtPreview');eq(p.tagName,'DETAILS','display panel is native details');eq(p.getAttribute('open'),null,'display panel initially closed');eq(c.tagName,'INPUT','preview native input');eq(c.getAttribute('type'),'checkbox','preview is checkbox');eq(c.getAttribute('autocomplete'),'off','form restoration discouraged by explicit browser hint');eq(c.getAttribute('checked'),null,'markup default unchecked');eq(g.run('vehicleArtPreview'),false,'fresh renderer default legacy');eq(c.checked,false,'fresh control unchecked');eq(g.run('unitArtPathCache'),undefined,'off bootstrap does not allocate paths');eq(g.run('buildingArtPathCache'),undefined,'off bootstrap does not allocate building paths');eq(c.getAttribute('aria-describedby'),'vehicleArtPreviewHelp','accessible help linkage');eq(g.elements.filter(n=>n.tagName==='LABEL'&&n.getAttribute('for')==='vehicleArtPreview').length,1,'one explicit accessible label');ok(html.includes('实验性车辆与建筑外观预览（各5种）'),'experimental combined vehicle/building label');ok(html.includes('新外观绘制开销可能更高'),'cost warning visible');ok(html.includes('仅本页面会话保留，新局沿用，重新打开页面恢复关闭'),'session-only lifecycle explicit');ok(html.includes('未验证原生浏览器效果与帧率'),'browser and FPS limitation visible')});
